name: Hougyou Iria
source:
An amnesiac girl who claims to have the same name as a famous virtual environment designer.

Extremely familiar with otaku culture from the late 20th and early 21st centuries, occasionally using slang that no one around her understands.

[Spoiler]Was held in the Ikebukuro CPC as a child, used in human experiments. These experiments granted her enhanced empathy. While at the Ikebukuro CPC, she was close friends with [url=/c34602]Con Su[/url] (known as Risa at the time).

After escaping from the Ikebukuro CPC, she lived with [url=/c85766]Sori Ayuka[/url] in The Fortress.

She is the sole human able to make contact with [url=/c58191]Substance-Concept[/url], due to her enhanced empathy.[/spoiler]

[From the in-game profile]
